item.title: ‘ The one, whose will is stronger, wins’ The marines of the 40th Separate Guards Brigade (the Vostok Group of Forces)
item.description: ‘ The one, whose will is stronger, wins’ 💬 The marines of the 40th Separate Guards Brigade (the Vostok Group of Forces) told about fighting to liberate the settlement of Nikolskoye (Zaporozhye region). ▫️ A serviceman with the call sign ‘Ten’ noted that in the battle everything was decided by the solid will of the fighters and competent support from the commanders: ‘The will has a very big influence. The one, whose will is stronger, wins the battle. The situations are different, but everyone wants to live, everyone is scared. That's why at this moment the commander's very first duty is to support his soldier, to show him, that the commander is close. We need to stay strong and go on’. 📊 During the battles, assault detachments established control over an area of about 13 square kilometres and mopped up more than 200 buildings. The following AFU elements were neutralised: ▪️ up to a company of manpower, ▪️ 15 armoured fighting vehicles, ▪️ 19 motor vehicles, ▪️ 29 ground robotic systems, ️️ ▪️ 48 heavy hexacopters. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30015

‘
The one, whose will is stronger, wins’
💬
The marines of the 40th Separate Guards Brigade (the Vostok Group of Forces)
told about fighting to liberate the settlement of
Nikolskoye
(Zaporozhye region).
▫️
A serviceman with the call sign ‘Ten’ noted that
in the battle everything was decided by the solid will of the fighters and competent support from the commanders:
‘The will has a very big influence. The one, whose will is stronger, wins the battle. The situations are different, but everyone wants to live, everyone is scared. That's why at this moment the commander's very first duty is to support his soldier, to show him, that the commander is close. We need to stay strong and go on’.
📊
During the battles, assault detachments
established control over an area of about 13 square kilometres and mopped up more than 200 buildings.
The following AFU elements were neutralised:
▪️
up to a company of manpower,
▪️
15 armoured fighting vehicles,
▪️
19 motor vehicles,
▪️
29 ground robotic systems,
️️
▪️
48 heavy hexacopters.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 13 October 2026

🔥
The Tsentr Group's units inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one air assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two national guard brigades close to Liman, Verovka, Belozerskoye, Svyatogorovka, Veselaya Gora, Maryevka, and Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
📍
In Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Marine units continued to mop up the controlled quarters of the city and the territory of the Dobropolskaya mine.
🚩
Over the past 24 hours, 286 buildings,
including three production facilities,
have been liberated,
up to 65 troops were neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 345 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and one Grad MLRS combat vehicle have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Gavrilovka, Tarasovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Dudnikovo, Zalivnoye, Blakitnoye, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 240 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 40 troops, 20 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
the defence industry enterprises and transport infrastructure facilities of Ukraine used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the production workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles and their depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️

883 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ➡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
➡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region tighten
the encirclement and expand the external control zone.
💥
Fights are underway in the encirclement
for the liberation of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, and Nefedovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU's encircled units lost up to 60 troops, one motor vehicle, and five ground robotic systems during the day.
➡️
In the course of combat operations to establish control over the settlements
of Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Gogino (Kharkov region), Russian elements continue to expand the external control zone.
🔥
In addition, in Kharkov region,
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade
have been hit
near Velikiye Prokhody, Khotomlya, Pogoreloye, Russkaya Lozovaya, Tsirkuny, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and two territorial defence brigades close to Glukhov, Yuryevo, Barilovka, Maryino, Konotop, Nikolskoye, and Sumy.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 270 troops, one tank, eight motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
📍
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line
and inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Grushevka, Blagodatovka, Berezovka, Maliyevka, Osinovo (Kharkov region), and Volchiy Yar (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 230 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 17 motor vehicles, three artillery guns, and four electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Semenovka, Slavyansk, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 160 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 31 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes with ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against defence industry e
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes with ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against defence industry enterprises, logistics centres, railway and port infrastructure facilities of Ukraine, as well as vessels delivering military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: 📍 in Kiev: ▪️ the Palp Mill Print production workshop, where long-range missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles were assembled; ▪️ a locomotive shed of Darnitsa, where maintenance and repair of the locomotive fleet were carried out; this fleet was used to transport military and dual-use cargo for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 📍 in Nikolayev region: ▪️ in the settlement of Ternovka, the Novaya Pochta logistics centre used to store dual-use cargo to support the AFU; ▪️ in the settlement of Meshkovo-Pogorelovo, a UAV depot. ⚓️ In addition, in Bugskoy Liman, a dry cargo ship delivering military and dual-use cargo to the port of Nikolayev was hit. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30008

▪️

a UAV depot.
⚓️
In addition, in Bugskoy Liman,
a dry cargo ship
delivering military and dual-use cargo to the port of Nikolayev was hit.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
